power_supply_induction.implementationEvidence: §4-3 Troubleshooting (Power) p.57: terminal block voltage 220–240V 50/60Hz; no-power flow checks wiring, circuit breaker, terminal block connections. §4-1 symptom matrix p.45: measure input voltage 240/120V or 208/120V at terminal block and main PCB L1~N 120V.
power_supply_induction.functionalMapping: Mains supply prerequisite is independently tested before PCB/heater paths — maps to frozen power_supply functional role.

control_board_induction.implementationEvidence: Main PCB + Sub PCB architecture; C-F0 Main↔Sub communication fault (p.41); bake/broil/convection/DLB relay checks on Main PCB diagram (p.39); §4-3 PCB failure flow checks SMPS 5V/12V and relay operation (p.58). Cooktop path routes through Assy-Inverter Module and Assy Touch PCB (§4-2-10 Communication p.56–57).
control_board_induction.functionalMapping: Control/orchestration remains representable as control_board — relay banks and inverter/touch packaging are implementation, not a separate canonical functional domain in this observation.
control_board_induction.topologyNotCanonical: control_board → Assy-Inverter Module → working coil is implementation evidence recorded below surface_heating_system — not promoted to canonical topology.

user_interface_induction.implementationEvidence: C-d0 key short (p.36, flow p.43); C-F2 Main↔Touch PCB communication (p.36, flow p.42); Glass Touch / Assy Touch PCB; keypad cable CN701; Virtual Flame option (p.47).
user_interface_induction.functionalMapping: UI/command interaction domain is separately diagnosed from heater and inverter power paths.

temperature_sensor_induction.implementationEvidence: C-20 oven sensor open/short (p.37, flow p.38); C-21 abnormal internal temperature with oven sensor 1080Ω at room temp (p.37, flow p.39); §4-3 component test oven sensor ~1080Ω at room temperature (p.62); oven sensor resistance table p.63.
temperature_sensor_induction.functionalMapping: Oven cavity temperature feedback is independently measured and fault-routed — same functional role as frozen temperature_sensor.

surface_heating_system_induction.implementationEvidence: Induction cooktop: 4 ceramic-glass zones (spec p.8); Assy-Working Coil sizes 160/180/280 (§3-6 p.15–17); Assy-Induction Module replacement (§3-7 p.18–20). Cooktop fault family §4-2: Top Sensor Open/Short (p.48–51), IGBT Sensor Open/Short on Assy-Inverter Module (p.52–53), Over Temperature (p.54), Pan Detection (p.55), DC Motor Locking (p.56), Communication Display↔Inverter UART (p.56–57). §4-3 Heating Failure: IGBT terminal resistance G-E/G-C/E-C, fuse at Filter PCB, Inverter PCB replacement (p.57).
surface_heating_system_induction.functionalMapping: Cooktop heat generation remains an independently diagnosable functional domain — manual decomposes surface problems into sensor/inverter/pan/coil paths without requiring a new canonical component for induction. Frozen surface_heating_system can express 'surface won't heat / cooktop fault' reasoning; coil/inverter/pan detection are implementation bindings.

scrutinyNotes.notEquivalentBecause: Induction surface heating is not equivalent to resistance element heating — manual tests inverter/IGBT/pan/coil paths.
scrutinyNotes.falsificationQuestion: Does diagnostic behavior require a functional concept surface_heating_system cannot express?
scrutinyNotes.observationalAnswer: Not evidenced on R1 — cooktop faults are addressable as surface heat-generation failures with platform implementation vocabulary.
scrutinyNotes.topologyNotCanonical: control_board → inverter module → working coil recorded as implementation — not canonical topology.

bake_instance_scope_induction.implementationEvidence: §3-10 Heater-Bake removal (p.23); §4-3 Bake Heater component test: resistance ~17–19Ω at room temp, terminal voltage AC 240V when bake keypad pressed >1 min (p.60); bake relay on Main PCB diagram (p.39); C-21 references bake heater resistance check (p.37).
bake_instance_scope_induction.functionalMapping: Bake oven heat function is independently testable (separate procedure, separate relay path, separate keypad activation) — maps to bake_heating_element instance scope as functional equivalence; electric bake element is implementation.

broil_instance_scope_induction.implementationEvidence: §3-9 Heater-Broil removal (p.22); §4-3 Broil Heater component test: resistance ~12–14Ω at room temp, terminal voltage AC 240V when broil keypad pressed (p.60); broil relay on Main PCB diagram (p.39).
broil_instance_scope_induction.functionalMapping: Broil oven heat function is independently testable — separate from bake — maps to broil_heating_element instance scope.

convection_heating_element_induction.implementationEvidence: §3-11 Convection Element removal (p.24); §4-3 Convection Heater component test: resistance ~41–46Ω at room temp, terminal voltage AC 240V on convection bake keypad >1 min (p.60); spec table lists convection element Yes 1250W/240V (p.8–9).
convection_heating_element_induction.functionalMapping: This configuration evidences a dedicated electric convection heating element test path — conditional instance scope binds on this platform (not fan-only convection).
convection_heating_element_induction.conditionalScopeNote: Evidenced on this configuration — distinct from CG-11 gas NO_EVIDENCE case.

convection_fan_induction.implementationEvidence: §4-3 Upper/Lower Convection Fan motor tests: resistance ~20–30Ω, terminal voltage 120V when bake keypad cycles fan (p.61); §4-1 symptom 'Convection fan is not spinning' checks convection fan relay on Sub PCB (p.47).
convection_fan_induction.functionalMapping: Convection fan actuator is independently diagnosable — frozen convection_fan conditional concept applies.

thermal_protection_induction.implementationEvidence: C-21 abnormal high internal temperature (p.37); C-30/C-31 PCB temp sensor faults (p.37); §4-1 thermostat 0Ω normal check (p.45); cooktop Over Temperature when Top sensor sees >482°F ceramic surface (§4-2-7 p.54); C-21 references broil/bake/convection heater and relay checks.
thermal_protection_induction.functionalMapping: Thermal protection behavior is evidenced through multiple platform-specific paths (oven overtemp, PCB temp, cooktop overtemp, thermostat) — fits frozen CONDITIONAL posture without assuming single implementation.

oven_door_switch_induction.implementationEvidence: C-d1 door lock mispositioned: lock motor 2500–2700Ω, 120V at motor, microswitch COM-NO checks (p.36, flow p.40); §4-3 door lock motor test p.61; §4-3 Door plunger switch open 0Ω / close ∞ (p.62); §3-8 Latch-Door & Switch-Door Plunger (p.21).
oven_door_switch_induction.functionalMapping: Door-state authorization evidenced via latch motor + plunger switch packaging — same conditional posture as electric/gas (actuator vs authorization function).
